name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=render/ui_menu, descriptor=chapter_intro_dialog_panels). Accurately reflects the purpose: renders the chapter-intro dialog panels (animated frame/scroll indicators + optional party roster) across three layout modes. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Render the chapter-intro dialog panels (background frame indicators + animated foreground sprites), dispatching three layout modes; called per BIOS-tick from fd2_wait_input_with_chapter_dialog_blink.
logic_summary: First advances the sub-frame cycler: if (frame_idx & 1) subframe_counter++, then if subframe_counter==4 reset to 0 (unconditional). Then dispatches on mode. mode 0: single-corner cursor indicator -- blit corner_offs[cursor_idx]+0xAD430 with atlas sprite atlas[+6+(frame_idx/2 + cursor_idx*2 + 3)*4]. mode 1/3: two scroll panels (and on mode 3 first overlays fd2_render_party_roster_grid(cursor_idx,0xA0000)); left panel @0xA972A picks static atlas[+0x4A] when scroll==0 else animated scroll-up sprite; right panel @0xAE36A picks animated scroll-down sprite when scroll+6<visible_count else static. mode 2: same two panels but the right cap uses scroll+3 instead of +6, plus a 3-icon party roster row -- icon_count=min(3,visible_count), anim_phase maps 0/1/2/3 -> 0/1/2/1, and for each icon blits a 24x24 portrait from the portrait cache (portrait_id from candidate_array[scroll+i]) at y=0x75+i*0x1A. frame_idx/2 is a signed divide.

params.name: corner_offs_ptr
params.semantics: Pointer to a u32[4] table of corner offsets (the caller copies tutorial_dialog_intro_constants_b @ [0x526EA] into a stack-local). Used only in mode 0 as *(int32*)(cursor_idx*4 + corner_offs_ptr) + 0xAD430 to compute the VRAM destination of the single-corner cursor sprite.
params.reason: Name accurately describes a pointer to the corner-offset table; no address residue.

params.name: mode
params.semantics: Dialog layout mode selector (0=single-corner cursor indicator, 1/3=two scroll panels with optional party-roster overlay, 2=two scroll panels + 3-icon party roster row).
params.reason: Name accurately describes the layout-mode dispatch value; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; performs rendering side-effects (sprite blits) only.
